# todo

Generated by AISE from the approved design. Requirements: [docs/requirements.md](docs/requirements.md), design and diagrams: [docs/design.md](docs/design.md).

Run it with Docker: see [RUN.md](RUN.md).

## Run

```sh
npm ci
npm start          # http://localhost:8080, PORT changes the port
npm test
npm run typecheck
```

Data is stored in `./data/todo.db`. `DB_PATH` changes the file; `DB_PATH=:memory:` keeps it in memory.

## Structure

`src/app/` wires the classes into an Express app and `src/app/main.ts` starts it; `public/` holds the web page. The JSDoc of each class carries a `@trace` tag naming its design element and requirements.

## Tasks app (DSN-004)

| Class | File | Design | Requirements | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Task | `src/tasks-app/Task.ts` | DSN-005 | REQ-001, REQ-002, REQ-007, REQ-009, REQ-010 | Task data record. dueDate is a calendar date string YYYY-MM-DD without time, or null when the task has none; existing tasks without one load as null. |
| TaskView | `src/tasks-app/TaskView.ts` | DSN-009 | REQ-010 | A Task as returned by GET /api/tasks, with the overdue flag computed by the server for the date the page sent. |
| TaskController | `src/tasks-app/TaskController.ts` | DSN-006 | REQ-001, REQ-002, REQ-004, REQ-005, REQ-006, REQ-007, REQ-008, REQ-009, REQ-010 | HTTP routes: GET /, GET /api/tasks (optional today query parameter, YYYY-MM-DD, the page's local date; returns tasks with an overdue flag), POST /api/tasks, PATCH /api/tasks/:id, DELETE /api/tasks/:id. Serves the single page without login. PATCH returns the updated Task so the page can re-render it. Bodies may carry dueDate (YYYY-MM-DD or null to clear). |
| TaskService | `src/tasks-app/TaskService.ts` | DSN-007 | REQ-001, REQ-002, REQ-005, REQ-006, REQ-007, REQ-009, REQ-010 | Validates text (trim, 1-200 chars) and optional due date (valid calendar date, no time), applies rules and orders the list by done state then creation time, independent of due dates. isOverdue is true only for an open task with a due date strictly before today (YYYY-MM-DD string comparison); list(today) adds that flag to each task, rejects an invalid today, and uses the server date when today is omitted. |
| TaskStore | `src/tasks-app/TaskStore.ts` | DSN-008 | REQ-003, REQ-006, REQ-009 | SQLite persistence of tasks inside the service process, including the nullable due date column; rows without a due date load with null. |
